title: 5 Day Fly-In Serengeti Wildebeest Migration Safari from Arusha
overview: Fly from Arusha straight into the heart of the Great Wildebeest Migration on this unforgettable 5-day Tanzania safari. Designed for travelers who want to witness the spectacular Mara River crossings without spending long hours on the road, this Fly-In Migration Safari takes you to Northern Serengeti during the peak migration season from July to October. Stay close to the action in carefully selected camps and enjoy thrilling game drives as thousands of wildebeest and zebras move through the Serengeti, alongside incredible opportunities to see lions, leopards, cheetahs, elephants, and other African wildlife. With scenic flights, prime migration locations, and unforgettable wildlife experiences, this safari offers an exciting and time-efficient way to experience the best of the Serengeti migration.
Itinerary

itinerary.title: Arusha to Northern Serengeti
text: Your safari adventure begins with a hotel pickup in Arusha and a transfer to Arusha Airport for a one-hour flight to Kogatende Airstrip in Northern Serengeti. Upon arrival, your private safari vehicle will be ready for an exciting Northern Serengeti game drive, with a visit to the Mara River to witness the spectacular Great Wildebeest Migration crossing.

From July to October, the Mara River in Northern Serengeti becomes the dramatic stage of the Great Migration. Wildebeest gather along the riverbanks before making the plunge, while crocodiles wait in the water and predators such as lions and hyenas patrol nearby.

You’ll spend time around Kogatende or Lamai, giving you a better opportunity to experience a river crossing when nature decides the moment is right. Between crossings, explore the quieter side of Northern Serengeti, where you may encounter lions on the kopjes, elephants in the Mara woodland, and fewer safari vehicles.

After an unforgettable day of wildlife and migration viewing, return to Safari Haven Migration Camp, a mobile migration camp ideally positioned in Northern Serengeti for the Mara River crossings, for dinner and a relaxing overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Full Day Game Drive - Northern Serengeti
text: Wake up early for an unforgettable Northern Serengeti game drive, with the main goal of witnessing the spectacular Mara River crossings of the Great Wildebeest Migration. From July to October, thousands of wildebeest and zebras gather along the Mara River, creating one of Africa’s most dramatic wildlife experiences.

Explore the Kogatende and Lamai areas, where you may encounter large herds, lions, elephants, leopards, and other Serengeti wildlife. After an exciting day in the north, enjoy a scenic game drive toward Central Serengeti, arriving at your camp in the evening.

itinerary.title: Full-Day Game Drive in Central Serengeti
text: Wake up in the heart of the Central Serengeti and enjoy a full day game drive through the legendary Seronera Valley, one of Tanzania’s premier wildlife viewing areas. Known for its year-round abundance of wildlife, Central Serengeti offers excellent opportunities to encounter lions, leopards, cheetahs, elephants, giraffes, buffaloes, zebras, wildebeest and other plains game across its stunning open savannah.

Start early to catch predators when they are most active, then continue exploring the Seronera River, rocky kopjes and acacia-dotted plains. Enjoy a picnic lunch in the wilderness before continuing your afternoon Serengeti safari game drive, searching for big cats resting around the kopjes and leopards in the riverine areas.
As the day comes to an end, return to your accommodation for dinner and a relaxing evening surrounded by the atmosphere of the Serengeti.

itinerary.title: Serengeti to Ngorongoro Crater
text: After breakfast, begin your journey from the Serengeti to Ngorongoro Crater with an exciting transfer game drive through the beautiful Tanzanian wilderness. Enjoy approximately three hours of wildlife viewing along the way, with opportunities to spot zebras, wildebeest, giraffes, elephants and other wildlife.

Around 10:00 AM, descend into the spectacular Ngorongoro Crater, a UNESCO World Heritage landscape and one of Tanzania’s most remarkable wildlife destinations. The 260 km² crater floor is home to an extraordinary concentration of wildlife, including lions, elephants, buffaloes, hippos, flamingos and the rare eastern black rhino.

Spend approximately five hours on a Ngorongoro Crater game drive, exploring the crater floor and its diverse habitats. Visit the soda lake, search for flamingos, explore the Lerai Forest and keep your eyes open for predators and large herds of plains game. After an unforgettable wildlife experience, ascend the crater and continue to your lodge for dinner and a relaxing overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Tarangire National Park Game Drive & Return to Arusha
text: After breakfast, depart Arusha for a scenic 90-minute drive to Tarangire National Park, one of Tanzania’s most spectacular wildlife destinations. Known for its impressive elephant herds, ancient baobab trees and diverse landscapes, Tarangire offers an unforgettable Tanzania safari experience.

Enjoy a full-day game drive through the park’s baobab-studded savannah, seasonal swamps and the Tarangire River. During the dry season, the river becomes a vital water source, attracting large herds of elephants and other wildlife. Keep your eyes open for lions, leopards, giraffes, zebras, wildebeest, antelopes and a remarkable variety of bird species.

Enjoy a hot picnic lunch in the wilderness before continuing your Tarangire safari game drive, making the most of the afternoon light and abundant wildlife. After an exciting day exploring Tarangire National Park, begin your drive back to Arusha, arriving in the late afternoon and marking the end of your safari adventure.
itinerary.stay: No overnight, Safari ends in Arusha

title: 7 Day Mara River Crossing Safari: The Great Wildebeest Migration
overview: Experience the Great Migration in Tanzania on a thrilling 7 day private safari through Tarangire, Serengeti and Ngorongoro. Discover elephant-filled landscapes and ancient baobabs in Tarangire before heading into the Central Serengeti for unforgettable wildlife encounters. Continue north to Northern Serengeti, where the legendary Mara River crossing takes center stage. Witness thousands of wildebeest and zebras gathering along the riverbanks as they follow the annual Great Migration, creating one of Africa’s most spectacular wildlife experiences.

itinerary.title: Arrival Kilimanjaro Airport to Arusha
text: Your Tanzania safari adventure begins the moment you arrive at Kilimanjaro International Airport (JRO). You’ll be warmly welcomed by your Plus Discovery Adventure representative, holding a personalized name board. From the airport, you’ll enjoy a comfortable transfer to your hotel in Arusha, nestled at the foothills of Mount Meru. Upon arrival, take time to relax, freshen up, and settle into your accommodation.

In the evening, enjoy a delicious dinner while meeting your safari guide, who will brief you on the exciting journey ahead and answer any questions about your Tanzania wildlife safari. After a restful night, you’ll be ready to begin your safari adventure.

itinerary.title: Arusha to Tarangire National Park
text: After breakfast, depart Arusha for a scenic drive to Tarangire National Park, one of Tanzania’s most rewarding wildlife destinations and renowned for its spectacular elephant herds and ancient baobab trees. Enjoy a full day Tarangire safari game drive through open savannah, seasonal swamps and the wildlife-rich Tarangire River. Especially during the dry season, the river attracts large concentrations of elephants and other wildlife. Keep your eyes open for lions, giraffes, zebras, wildebeest, impalas, fringe-eared oryx, dwarf mongooses and an impressive variety of birdlife.

A delicious picnic lunch will be served in the park, allowing you to spend more time enjoying the wildlife and beautiful scenery. Continue your afternoon game drive before leaving Tarangire and heading to Karatu for a relaxing evening and overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Karatu to Central Serengeti National Park
text: After breakfast, travel through the Ngorongoro Conservation Area to the world-famous Serengeti National Park, enjoying wildlife viewing along the way. Enter Central Serengeti and explore the scenic Seronera Valley, renowned for year-round wildlife and exceptional big-cat sightings. Continue with a guided game drive across the endless Serengeti plains, searching for lions, leopards, cheetahs, elephants, giraffes, and zebras. Arrive at Nakupenda Luxury Camp for dinner and a relaxing overnight stay in the heart of the Serengeti.

itinerary.title: Northern Serengeti & Mara River Great Migration
text: Travel north through the Serengeti on a scenic game drive toward the Mara River, the legendary stage of the Great Migration. Between July and October, the northern Serengeti offers exceptional opportunities to witness wildebeest and zebra gathering near the river and, when conditions align, dramatic river crossings.
Continue through Kogatende or Lamai, exploring the northern plains for lions, elephants, giraffes, and other wildlife before arriving at your intimate mobile camp near the river.
An optional sunrise hot air balloon safari is available at an additional cost.
itinerary.stay: Moyo Migration Camp In Northern Serengeti

itinerary.title: Mara River Great Migration & Northern Serengeti Safari
text: Wake early for a sunrise game drive around the Mara River, one of the best areas to experience the Great Migration. From July to October, wildebeest and zebra gather along the riverbanks, creating unforgettable opportunities to witness dramatic river crossings. After lunch, begin a scenic game drive south through the Serengeti, enjoying wildlife sightings and the golden landscapes as you return to Central Serengeti.
itinerary.stay: Nakupenda Luxury Camp in Central Serengeti

itinerary.title: Serengeti to Ngorongoro Crater Safari
text: After breakfast, enjoy a final Serengeti game drive as you journey toward the Ngorongoro Conservation Area. Descend into the spectacular Ngorongoro Crater for an unforgettable game drive, searching for lions, elephants, buffalo, hippos, hyenas, and the endangered black rhino.
Explore the crater floor with its rich wildlife and dramatic landscapes before ascending the crater rim and continuing to Karatu for a relaxing evening.

itinerary.title: Karatu to Arusha – Hotel or Airport Drop-Off
text: After breakfast, depart Karatu and drive back to Arusha, enjoying the scenic countryside along the way. Depending on your flight schedule, you may have free time in Arusha before your transfer to your hotel, Kilimanjaro International Airport (JRO), or Arusha Airport (ARK) for your onward journey.

title: 3 Day Great Migration River Crossing Safari: Zanzibar Fly-In & Fly-Out
overview: Experience the Great Migration in Northern Serengeti on a thrilling 3 day fly in, fly out safari from Zanzibar. Fly directly from Zanzibar to Kogatende Airstrip and spend three unforgettable days exploring the Northern Serengeti during the peak Mara River crossing season.

Enjoy exciting game drives in search of massive wildebeest and zebra herds, dramatic river crossings when conditions allow, and iconic wildlife including lions, leopards, elephants and giraffes. After your safari, fly back to Zanzibar, making this the perfect short Great Migration safari from Zanzibar.
Itinerary

itinerary.title: Zanzibar to Northern Serengeti Mara River Crossing
text: Your 3 day Great Migration safari from Zanzibar begins with a hotel pickup and transfer to Zanzibar Airport for your flight to Northern Serengeti National Park. Upon arrival at Kogatende Airstrip around 11:00 AM, your private safari vehicle and professional Plus Discovery Adventure guide will be waiting for you. Begin your Northern Serengeti game drive as you head toward the Mara River, one of the most spectacular locations to witness the Great Wildebeest Migration. From July to October, thousands of wildebeest and zebras gather along the riverbanks before attempting the dramatic crossing, while crocodiles and predators wait nearby.

itinerary.title: Full Day Northern Serengeti Great Migration Safari
text: Rise early for a full day Northern Serengeti safari, with the main focus on the Mara River crossing and the Great Migration. Spend the day exploring the remote northern Serengeti, following wildlife movements and searching for opportunities to witness a river crossing. Northern Serengeti is not only famous for the migration. The region also offers exceptional wildlife viewing, including lions, elephants, giraffes, zebras, wildebeest and numerous bird species. Look out for magnificent birds such as ostriches, secretary birds and black eagles soaring above the savannah.

itinerary.title: Northern Serengeti & Fly Out to Zanzibar
text: Enjoy a final early morning game drive in Northern Serengeti, giving you one last opportunity to experience the wildlife and landscapes of the Serengeti. After the game drive, proceed to Kogatende Airstrip for your late morning flight back to Zanzibar. Upon arrival in Zanzibar, your 3 day Zanzibar to Serengeti fly in fly out safari comes to an end, leaving you with unforgettable memories of the Great Migration and the spectacular Mara River.

title: 8 Day Great Migration Calving Season Safari (Mid-Range)
overview: Experience an unforgettable 8 day Tanzania Great Migration safari timed for the spectacular calving season in Ndutu and the Southern Serengeti. This carefully designed safari combines Tarangire’s elephant rich landscapes, the wildlife packed Central Serengeti, the dramatic Great Migration calving season, and the iconic Ngorongoro Crater. From thousands of newborn wildebeest calves to intense predator action, this is one of the most exciting times of year for a Serengeti safari. Travel in a private 4x4 safari vehicle with an experienced guide and stay in carefully selected mid range lodges and tented camps.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Arusha
text: Kilimanjaro International Airport / Arusha Airport to Arusha

Your Tanzania safari begins with a warm welcome at Kilimanjaro International Airport (JRO) or Arusha Airport (ARK). Our Plus Discovery Adventure representative will meet you and transfer you to your hotel in Arusha. After check in, enjoy a relaxed evening at leisure and prepare for your safari adventure. Depending on your arrival time, your safari guide can provide a briefing about the journey ahead.

itinerary.title: Arusha to Tarangire National Park & Karatu
text: After breakfast, your safari guide will pick you up around 8:00 am and drive approximately two hours to Tarangire National Park, famous for its large elephant herds, ancient baobab trees and wildlife rich landscapes. Enjoy a full day game drive through the park’s savannah, seasonal swamps and the Tarangire River. Keep your eyes open for elephants, lions, leopards, giraffes, zebras, wildebeest, impalas, elands, warthogs and an impressive variety of birdlife.
Enjoy a picnic lunch at Matete Picnic Site before continuing your afternoon game drive. Later, drive to Karatu for dinner and a relaxing overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Karatu to Central Serengeti
text: After an early breakfast, depart Karatu and travel through the scenic Ngorongoro Highlands toward Serengeti National Park. As you enter the Serengeti, the landscape opens into vast golden plains and wildlife rich savannah. Enjoy game viewing along the way before continuing into the Central Serengeti and Seronera Valley, one of Tanzania’s best areas for year round wildlife viewing. The region is renowned for its lions, leopards, cheetahs, elephants, giraffes, zebras and large concentrations of wildebeest and other plains game.
Arrive at your tented camp for dinner and an evening surrounded by the sounds of the Serengeti wilderness.

itinerary.title: Full Day Central Serengeti Safari
text: Spend a full day exploring Central Serengeti, with a particular focus on the Seronera Valley and its surrounding plains. Set out early when wildlife is most active and search for lions, cheetahs and leopards. The area’s rocky kopjes, acacia woodlands and riverine habitats provide excellent opportunities for wildlife viewing and photography. Enjoy a picnic lunch in the wilderness before continuing your afternoon game drive. As the sun begins to set, return to camp for dinner and a relaxing evening beneath the African sky.

itinerary.title: Central Serengeti to Ndutu – Great Migration Calving Season
text: After breakfast, begin your journey toward Ndutu and the Southern Serengeti, the heart of the Great Migration calving season. From December through April, the short grass plains around Ndutu become an important gathering area for migrating wildebeest and other herbivores. The abundance of newborn calves also attracts predators, creating exceptional opportunities to witness lions, cheetahs and hyenas in action. Enjoy game viewing as you travel toward the Ndutu area before arriving at your mobile migration camp.

itinerary.title: Full Day Ndutu Calving Season Safari
text: Explore Ndutu & Southern Serengeti
Today is dedicated entirely to the Great Migration calving season in Ndutu.

Set out early for a full-day game drive across the open plains, following the migrating herds and searching for newborn wildebeest calves. The concentration of young animals makes this one of the most fascinating periods for wildlife enthusiasts and photographers. The open grasslands also provide excellent opportunities to see predators such as lions, cheetahs, hyenas and other wildlife taking advantage of the abundance of prey. For an additional unforgettable experience, you may choose to enjoy a hot air balloon safari over the Serengeti plains, available at an additional cost.

itinerary.title: Ndutu to Ngorongoro Crater & Karatu
text: Wake up early for a final morning game drive in Ndutu, then continue toward the spectacular Ngorongoro Crater. Descend into the crater for an exciting game drive through one of Tanzania’s most remarkable wildlife destinations. The crater floor is home to large concentrations of wildlife, including lions, elephants, buffaloes, zebras, wildebeest, hippos and, with luck, the endangered black rhino.
Enjoy a picnic lunch during your crater adventure before ascending the crater walls and continuing to Karatu.

itinerary.title: Karatu to Arusha (Kilimanjaro International Airport / Arusha Airport)
text: After breakfast, begin your journey back to Arusha. Depending on your flight schedule, you may have time to relax or explore Arusha before your transfer to Kilimanjaro International Airport (JRO) or Arusha Airport (ARK) for your onward flight.
Your 8-day Serengeti Great Migration safari comes to an end with unforgettable memories of Tanzania’s wildlife, landscapes and the spectacular calving season.

title: 4 Day Ndutu Calving Season Safari: Great Migration & Ngorongoro Crater
overview: Experience the spectacular Serengeti calving season on this 4 day Tanzania safari through Ndutu and the Southern Serengeti, combined with a memorable game drive in the Ngorongoro Crater. From December to April, the short grass plains become a nursery for the Great Migration, with thousands of wildebeest calves born and predators such as lions, cheetahs and hyenas drawn to the area.
This carefully designed midrange Tanzania safari combines excellent wildlife viewing, comfortable tented accommodation and the dramatic landscapes of the Southern Serengeti.
highlights: Experience the Ndutu calving season in the Southern Serengeti
Witness thousands of wildebeest and zebra calves on the open plains
Search for lions, cheetahs and hyenas attracted by the abundance of newborn wildlife
Enjoy full-day game drives in the Ndutu migration area
Explore the spectacular Ngorongoro Crater
Stay in comfortable midrange tented accommodation
Travel with a professional Plus Discovery Adventure guide
Ideal for travellers seeking a short Tanzania Great Migration safari
bestTime: The Ndutu calving season generally takes place from December to March, when the Great Migration moves through the Southern Serengeti and Ndutu plains. Wildlife conditions can vary from year to year, but this period is renowned for exceptional concentrations of wildebeest, newborn calves and predator activity.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Arusha & Optional Arusha City Tour
text: Upon arrival at Kilimanjaro International Airport (JRO) or Arusha Airport (ARK), you will be warmly welcomed by the Plus Discovery Adventure team and transferred to your hotel in Arusha. Depending on your arrival time, you can relax at the hotel or enjoy an optional Arusha city tour, visiting local markets, the Cultural Heritage Centre and the colourful Maasai Market. It is a great opportunity to experience local culture and purchase authentic Tanzanian crafts and souvenirs.

itinerary.title: Arusha to Ndutu to Southern Serengeti Calving Season
text: After breakfast, depart Arusha and travel towards Ndutu, passing through the scenic landscapes of the Ngorongoro Conservation Area before entering the Southern Serengeti ecosystem. During the December to April calving season, the Ndutu plains become one of the most spectacular wildlife areas in Tanzania. The nutrient rich short grass provides excellent grazing for the migrating wildebeest and zebras, while the concentration of newborn animals attracts numerous predators.

After arriving in the Ndutu area, enjoy an afternoon game drive through the calving plains, searching for wildebeest, zebra, gazelles, lions, cheetahs, hyenas and other wildlife. As the sun begins to set, continue to your camp for dinner and an overnight stay surrounded by the sounds of the African wilderness.

itinerary.title: Full Day Ndutu Game Drive Serengeti Calving Season
text: Wake early for an unforgettable sunrise game drive in Ndutu, when the plains are at their most active. You may return to camp for breakfast before continuing your exploration, or choose a full day bush experience with packed breakfast and lunch.

Spend the day exploring the Ndutu calving grounds, where the Great Migration gathers during the calving season. Watch newborn wildebeest and zebra calves take their first steps while predators patrol the surrounding plains. With patience and a little luck, you may encounter lions, cheetahs, hyenas and other predators hunting across the open grasslands. The combination of abundant wildlife, dramatic predator activity and spectacular scenery makes Ndutu one of the most rewarding places to experience the Great Migration in Tanzania.

itinerary.title: Ngorongoro Crater Game Drive & Return to Arusha
text: After an early breakfast, depart Ndutu and continue towards the Ngorongoro Crater. Descend into the crater for an extended game drive across its spectacular wildlife rich floor. The Ngorongoro Crater is one of Tanzania’s most remarkable wildlife destinations and offers excellent opportunities to see buffaloes, elephants, hippos, hyenas, zebras, wildebeest, lions and, with luck, the endangered black rhino.

Enjoy a picnic lunch while taking in the dramatic scenery before ascending the crater walls and beginning the journey back to Arusha. Arrive in Arusha in the evening, where you will be dropped off at your hotel or transferred to Kilimanjaro International Airport or Arusha Airport for your onward journey.

title: 3 Day Zanzibar to Serengeti Fly-In & Fly-Out Calving Migration Safari
overview: December to April only experience the spectacular Serengeti wildebeest calving season on a short, action packed safari flying directly from Zanzibar to Serengeti. Explore the wildlife rich Seronera Valley before spending a full day in the Ndutu and Southern Serengeti calving plains, where thousands of wildebeest gather to give birth and predators follow closely behind. Enjoy comfortable midrange tented camp accommodation in Ndutu and maximize your time in the wilderness with convenient flights in and out of Zanzibar.

itinerary.title: Fly from Zanzibar to Serengeti & Game Drive
text: Your adventure begins with a hotel pickup in Zanzibar and transfer to the airport for your flight to Seronera Airstrip in the Serengeti. Upon arrival, meet your private Plus Discovery Adventure guide and begin your first game drive through the central Serengeti. You will gradually head south toward the Ndutu plains, following the migration route and watching for lions, cheetahs, leopards, elephants, giraffes, zebras and other wildlife along the way. The Seronera area is particularly famous for its year round wildlife and excellent big cat sightings.
Continue toward Ndutu for dinner and your overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Full Day Wildebeest Calving Safari
text: Rise early for a full day of wildlife viewing across the Ndutu calving plains, the heart of the Great Migration during the calving season. From December to April, vast herds of wildebeest gather across the short-grass plains to give birth. Thousands of calves can be seen during this period, attracting lions, cheetahs, hyenas and other predators. Your experienced Plus Discovery Adventure guide will search the plains for dramatic wildlife encounters while also looking for resident species such as giraffes, zebras, gazelles and elephants. Enjoy a picnic lunch in the bush before continuing your afternoon game drive. As the sun begins to set, return to camp for dinner and a relaxing evening.

itinerary.title: Morning Game Drive & Fly Back to Zanzibar
text: Start your final morning with an early game drive across the Ndutu and Serengeti plains. The early hours offer excellent opportunities to see predators returning from the night’s hunt and wildlife becoming active in the cool morning air. After the game drive, enjoy a picnic breakfast before continuing toward Seronera Airstrip for your scheduled flight back to Zanzibar. Upon arrival in Zanzibar, you will be met by your driver and transferred to your hotel, marking the end of your Plus Discovery Adventure Serengeti Calving Safari.

title: 6 Day Tanzania Wildebeest Calving Safari: Ndutu, Serengeti & Ngorongoro
overview: Experience one of Tanzania’s most spectacular wildlife events on this 6-day private Tanzania calving safari, specially designed around the Great Migration wildebeest calving season in Ndutu and the Southern Serengeti from December to March.

Your journey combines the wildlife rich landscapes of Tarangire National Park, the spectacular Ngorongoro Crater, two nights in the heart of the Ndutu calving grounds, and a fascinating cultural experience with the Hadzabe and Datoga communities at Lake Eyasi.

Stay close to the migration as thousands of wildebeest gather across the short-grass plains, with excellent opportunities to witness newborn calves, large herds, cheetahs, lions, hyenas and other predators drawn to the abundance of young wildlife.
highlights: Witness the Great Migration calving season in Ndutu
Search for newborn wildebeest and dramatic predator action
Enjoy two nights in the Southern Serengeti / Ndutu
Experience a full day wildlife safari in the Ndutu plains
Explore Ngorongoro Crater on a crater floor game drive
Discover the elephants and baobab landscapes of Tarangire National Park
Meet the Hadzabe and Datoga communities at Lake Eyasi
Travel with a private 4x4 safari vehicle and professional guide
Optional Ndutu hot air balloon safari available at an additional cost

itinerary.title: Arrival in Arusha
text: Kilimanjaro International Airport or Arusha Airport – Arusha

Upon arrival at Kilimanjaro International Airport (JRO) or Arusha Airport (ARK), you will be warmly welcomed by the Plus Discovery Adventure team and transferred to your hotel in Arusha. Depending on your arrival time, you may enjoy an optional Arusha city tour, visiting local markets, the Maasai Market or Cultural Heritage Centre before settling into your accommodation. In the evening, relax at your hotel and meet your safari guide, who will brief you about the adventure ahead.

itinerary.title: Arusha to Tarangire National Park & Karatu
text: After breakfast, your Plus Discovery Adventure guide will pick you up at around 8:00 AM and drive to Tarangire National Park, one of northern Tanzania’s most rewarding wildlife destinations. Famous for its enormous elephant herds, ancient baobab trees and wildlife-rich Tarangire River, the park offers excellent opportunities to see elephants, giraffes, zebras, wildebeest, impalas, elands, warthogs, lions and numerous bird species. Enjoy a picnic lunch in the park before continuing with an afternoon game drive through the savannah and seasonal wetlands.
Later, leave Tarangire and continue toward the Karatu area for dinner and your overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Ngorongoro Crater Game Drive to Southern Serengeti
text: After an early breakfast, depart for the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and descend into the spectacular Ngorongoro Crater for game drive. The crater floor supports an extraordinary concentration of wildlife. Keep watch for lions, elephants, buffaloes, hippos, zebras, wildebeest, flamingos and, with luck, the endangered black rhino.

From December to March, the short-grass plains of Ndutu become the heart of the Great Migration calving season. Hundreds of thousands of wildebeest gather here to give birth, creating one of the most dramatic predator-prey spectacles in Africa.

itinerary.title: Full-Day Game Drive in Southern Serengeti
text: Rise early for a full day of wildlife exploration in the Ndutu calving grounds, one of the best places in Tanzania to experience the Great Migration between December and March.
The morning game drive takes you across open short-grass plains, seasonal lakes and woodland areas where wildebeest, zebras and gazelles gather in large numbers.

This is an exceptional period for wildlife photography and predator sightings. Young wildebeest attract lions, cheetahs, hyenas and other predators, while large herds move across the plains in search of fresh grazing.
Enjoy a picnic lunch during the safari before continuing your afternoon game drive and returning to camp around sunset.
For an unforgettable perspective, you can also add an optional hot-air balloon safari over Ndutu, available at an additional cost.

itinerary.title: Southern Serengeti to Karatu
text: After breakfast, enjoy your final morning game drive in the Ndutu and Southern Serengeti region. Continue searching for wildlife around the seasonal lakes, plains and woodland edges, with opportunities to see wildebeest, zebras, gazelles, giraffes and the predators that follow the migration.
After lunch, begin the scenic journey toward Karatu, a fertile highland town surrounded by coffee farms and located close to the Ngorongoro Conservation Area.
Arrive at your lodge in the afternoon and enjoy a relaxing evening.

itinerary.title: Lake Eyasi Cultural Experience & Arusha
text: Hadzabe & Datoga – Return to Arusha

After an early breakfast, depart for Lake Eyasi, a beautiful Rift Valley lake and home to the Hadzabe and Datoga communities. Visit the Hadzabe, one of Tanzania’s indigenous hunter-gatherer communities, and learn about their traditional lifestyle, relationship with nature and centuries-old cultural practices.

Continue to a Datoga community, renowned for traditional metalworking and blacksmithing. Observe their craftsmanship and learn more about their daily life and cultural traditions. After the cultural experience and lunch, begin your journey back to Arusha, arriving in the late afternoon or evening.
Your 6 day Tanzania calving safari concludes in Arusha, with an optional transfer to Kilimanjaro International Airport or Arusha Airport depending on your onward travel arrangements.

title: 8 Day Lake Natron & Mara River Migration Crossing Safari
overview: Experience an unforgettable 8 day Tanzania safari combining the dramatic landscapes of Lake Natron, the elephant-rich wilderness of Tarangire National Park, the legendary Serengeti National Park, the spectacular Mara River migration crossings, and the wildlife-rich Ngorongoro Crater.

Designed for July to October, this private mid range safari follows the Great Migration into the Northern Serengeti, where vast herds of wildebeest gather around the Mara River. Along the way, discover Lake Natron’s flamingos, volcanic scenery and waterfalls before continuing through Tanzania’s most iconic wildlife areas.

Explore remote Lake Natron and its spectacular flamingo-filled soda lake
Hike to the beautiful Engare Sero Waterfalls
Enjoy a full-day game drive in Tarangire National Park
Explore the wildlife-rich Central Serengeti
Experience a spectacular Ngorongoro Crater safari
Stay in comfortable mid-range tented camps and lodges
Private 4x4 safari vehicle with a professional safari guide
